NapCat.Shell third-party runtime

Source: https://github.com/NapNeko/NapCatQQ
Copyright © 2024 Mlikiowa
License: see LICENSE.txt in this directory.
This redistribution is for non-commercial use under the upstream license.
Version and runtime checksum: see chatbot-bundle.json.

The upstream napcat.mjs, native modules, dependencies and WebUI assets are
copied from an existing installed release without modifying their code.
Dependency license files remain in node_modules.

Chatbot supplies a separate chatbot-launcher.cmd, a relocatable loadNapCat.js
and clean local-only configuration templates. No original login configuration,
tokens, account-specific configuration, databases, logs or cache are included.
At first use Chatbot creates independent local tokens in the recipient's folder.
